breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the standard flexure formula σ = (M * y) / I, which produces a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis (y = 0). It does not treat the bending stress as uniform over the section depth. The formula is applied at y = 25 mm, y = 50 mm (top fiber), and y = -50 mm (bottom fiber), all consistent with the ground truth's linear distribution approach.
